content.title: Aidan Miller | USA Baseball
content.text: 18U NATIONAL TEAM TRAINING CAMPInvited to the 2022 18U National Team Training Camp after participating in the PDP League.18U NATIONAL TEAMStarted all nine games for Team USA and batted .478…Named to the All-World Team as a right fielder…Earned title of Batting Champion…Became third player since 2010 to hit three triples in single tournament…Hit two triples and scored three runs against the Netherlands on September 9…Had a hit and two RBIs against Korea on September 10…Notched three hits and finished a double shy of the cycle, driving in three runs against South Africa on September 11…Collected a hit against Canada on September 12…Went 2-for-3 with a home run, two RBIs, and three runs scored against Brazil on September 13…Scored a run against Chinese Taipei on September 15…Had a hit, RBI, and run scored against Mexico on September 16…Went 1-for-3 against Japan on September 17…Scored a run in the title game against Chinese Taipei on September 18.2021 16U/17U NATIONAL TEAM DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMMember of the 2022 16U/17U National Team Development Program.15U NATIONAL TEAMStarted in right field for the U.S. in all nine games of the World Baseball Softball Confederation (WBSC) U-15 Baseball World Cup Americas Qualifier...Second on Team USA in walks after drawing eight throughout the tournament...Walked three times and scored two runs in Team USA's 11-4 victory over14U NATIONAL TEAM DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMMember of the 2018 14U National Team Development Program12U NATIONAL TEAMAppeared in seven games as a hitter and pitched 2.0 innings as a member of the 2016 12U National Team that racked up a record of 9-2 and won silver at the 2016 COPABE Pan Am Championships in Puebla, Mexico … Batted .400 with an OBP of .400 … Tallied a pair of hits, including slugging a home run … Totaled four RBIs and scored a pair of runs … Posted a 1-0 record over 2.0 innings with a 17.50 ERA … Struck out a pair of batters while allowing four hits and five earned runs
